data.headline: Target group
data.text: Graduates of courses of study that build on fundamentals from the fields of engineering (e.g. applied engineering), electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, physics, computer science, supply engineering or comparable.

data.headline: Annotation
data.text: The events take place at the campus in Feuchtwangen.

data.headline: Admission requirements
data.text:
1. A successfully completed university degree in a relevant degree course or an equivalent domestic or foreign academic degree with an overall examination grade of at least 2.3, the scope of which generally comprises 210 ECTS points, but at least 180 ECTS points

2. Proof of sufficient German (at least level A2) and knowledge of English (at least level B2).

3. Proof of above-average motivation by means of a letter of motivation
